why: No single major reviewer answers "best Qi2.2 25W 3-in-1 stand under $120" head-on, but several famous testers cover it in part: WIRED has two tested 3-in-1 roundups (one travel-focused, one 30+ models with picks at 15W Qi2 or $169), Good Housekeeping tested a 25W 3-in-1 at $120, and Macworld, 9to5Mac, Cult of Mac and MacSources each review a single qualifying stand (ESR CryoBoost, Kuxiu X40 Turbo). The rest of the results are ESR and Kuxiu brand pages (over a dozen duplicates), retailer listings, deal posts and AI/affiliate listicles. A focused page comparing the Qi2.2 25W stands under $120 with prices, codes and compatibility would stand out, but it competes with WIRED and the Macworld reviews for citation.
